faqs.q: Which transactions are not eligible for cashback?
faqs.a: You can earn cashback on online spends and offline spends except fuel, cash withdrawal and returns and exchange transactions.

faqs.q: Is there any fee charged on the redemption of cashback?
faqs.a: No, there is no fee charged on the redemption of cashback earned via the Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card.

faqs.q: Is the extended interest-free credit period also applicable on cash transactions?
faqs.a: No, the extended interest-free credit period of 90 days is not applicable on cash transactions done on the Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card. Cash transactions are charged at an interest rate of 3.75% per month.

faqs.q: Can I avail the interest-free credit period on Loan against credit card, EMI and balance transfer facility?
faqs.a: No, the interest-free credit period is only applicable on retail transactions done via this credit card. The payments for these services- Loan, EMI and balance transfer are serviced separately.

faqs.q: Are there any transactions thresholds for earning cashback ?
faqs.a: There are no minimum transaction value or minimum spends requirement for earning cashback.

faqs.q: What are the benefits of Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card?
faqs.a: Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card is a cashback card that offers 2% cashback on online spends and 1% cashback on offline spends. In addition, the card offers an interest-free period of up to 90 days and a low-interest EMI facility.

faqs.q: What is the annual fee for Standard Chartered Smart Card?
faqs.a: Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card charges a joining and annual fee of Rs. 499 plus applicable taxes. However, the annual fee can be waived off by spending Rs. 1.2 Lakh or more in a year.

faqs.q: Does Standard Chartered Smart Card provide lounge access?
faqs.a: No, Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card does not offer domestic or international lounge access benefits.
